messages:
maria: Quick sync: product wants to shrink the quota header from 'x-rd-quota' -> 'x-rd-q' to save bytes on high-throughput customers. Proposal: SDKs offer an opt-in 'shortHeader' mode that dual-writes both headers for two releases, then we drop legacy server-side after parity checks.

ezra: +1 to opt-in. Please do NOT flip default. We need a telemetry signal per request to compare counts.

tess: repro from local TS when only short header sent -> validator rejected. Short header not yet whitelisted in the proxy. We'll need server-side acceptance landed before any SDK switches.

brad: infra will add x-rd-q to staging whitelist today. won't touch prod until canary metrics look good.

leo: SDK design idea:
- config: `{ quotaHeader: 'legacy' | 'short' | 'both' }` default 'legacy'
- if 'both', client sets both headers and emits telemetry tag `quota_header=both`
- add a lightweight probe endpoint so SDK can detect server support in 'auto' mode later

edge-bot: Staging proxy updated: x-rd-q allowed.

docs-bot: I'll create a short migration guide + changelog entry when we have exact names.

maria: timeline suggestion: TS canary next Tue with `both` flag, Py following week, Go after that. Action items: TS PR (ezra), proxy whitelist (brad), telemetry tag (tess), docs (docs-bot).

ezra: I'll own the TS PR and add unit tests for header ordering and telemetry.

tess: I'll wire `quota_header` into request events so dashboard can filter.

maria: OK. Acceptance criteria: 24h parity check in staging with <0.5% mismatch before we remove legacy header server-side. Reconvene after TS canary. Thanks!
